verdict.rationale: Chronicle Labs is an agent simulation and evaluation platform, so user-defined event-triggered automation rules are a fair question, but the evidence never documents a rules or trigger engine. The SDK claim that you can "automate workflows" in several languages is a developer building block. The "autonomous fix and rollback" monitoring is vendor-driven behavior, not user-defined rules mapping events to actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
